caseNameFull: Fusari, Commissioner of Labor v. Steinberg

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. Conn. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 415 U. S. 912.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that John M. Creane, Esquire, of Milford, Conn., a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for appellees in this case.
